In continuation of our letters dated October 26, 2026 and October 31, 2026, and pursuant to the 
provisions of Regulation 30 and 46 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”), the

Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year 
ended September 30, 2026, conducted through virtual means, concluded on Saturday, October 
31,
